usedFor: Ricky answers customers in its shared inbox, and HubSpot is where sales tracks the opportunity. A “New Contact Created” in Ricky can run “Create Deal” in HubSpot, so someone who messages you gets a deal.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact Created” in Ricky, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A contact is created with a first message or through the API, which is the first sign of interest. “Create Deal” opens it in the pipeline.

watchOut: “Updated Contact” fires whenever a contact's fields, tags or custom values are saved, so it would make a second deal for the same person. Prefer “New Contact Created”.
